items.title: COP31 draft proposes at least $120 billion annually for climate adaptation by 2035
items.summary: The COP31 draft proposes raising annual climate adaptation finance for developing countries to at least US$120 billion by 2035, giving a specific financial target to an earlier commitment to triple funding. It also calls for a roadmap to deliver the money, stronger action to phase out fossil fuels and an end to certain unilateral climate-related trade measures by 2027. The proposals remain subject to negotiations and have not yet been adopted.
